title: Prefix freeness of gate encoding
statement: The encoding of Boolean circuit gates is prefix-free in the following sense: if the encoding of a gate $a$ followed by a Boolean list $s$ equals the encoding of a gate $b$ followed by a Boolean list $t$, then $a=b$ and $s=t$.
hypotheses_covered: The encoding of $a$ followed by $s$ equals the encoding of $b$ followed by $t$
